description: Get the full text of one prompt from the thinkhard.si repository by its slug, registry number (such as CAR-001) or exact title, with its {{blanks}}, what goes in each, and why it works. If the name does not match exactly, it answers with the closest matches instead. Pass values to fill blanks with the user's details. Ask the user for any blank you cannot fill from the conversation instead of inventing it.

prompt.description: The slug, registry number or exact title from search_prompts.

values.description: Optional: blank name → the user's text, for example {"job_posting": "..."}.

name: get_prompt

open_blanks.description: Blanks still to fill. Ask the user for these.

prompt.description: The user message, with the given values filled in.

system.description: The system prompt, with the given values filled in. Empty when the template has none.

title: Get a prompt template
